title: DID Management — Account Exempt — payload
description: An administrator exempts a self-registered account from its domain's terms, or holds it to them again. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

subject.description: The account, by the DID it registered as. A `did:scid` is compared without its `src`.

exempt.description: `true`: the domain's terms no longer apply to the account. `false`: they apply again.

Response.title: DID Management — Account Exempt — response payload
Response.description: The account after the request. Failures use trust-task-error, not this shape.

changed.description: `false` when the account already stood as requested.
